items.name: utils
items.description: cn()/cv() class utilities and custom-element interop helpers.

items.name: theme
items.description: shadcn-compatible CSS variable tokens (light + dark) for Tailwind v4.

items.name: roving-focus
items.description: Roving-tabindex keyboard navigation (arrow keys, Home/End, wrap) for composite widgets like tabs.

items.name: dismissable-layer
items.description: Escape-key + outside-pointer dismissal with a LIFO layer stack, for dialogs, popovers, and dropdowns.

items.name: focus
items.description: Focus trap and focus restore for modal surfaces like dialogs.

items.name: floating
items.description: Anchored positioning for floating elements: side/align placement, viewport flip, scroll/resize tracking.

items.name: typeahead
items.description: Printable-key item search for menus and listboxes, with Radix cycle-on-repeat semantics.

items.name: button
items.description: Displays a button. Port of shadcn/ui button.

items.name: badge
items.description: Displays a badge or a component that looks like a badge. Port of shadcn/ui badge.

items.name: label
items.description: Renders an accessible label associated with controls. Port of shadcn/ui label.

items.name: separator
items.description: Visually or semantically separates content. Port of shadcn/ui separator.

items.name: skeleton
items.description: A placeholder to show while content is loading. Port of shadcn/ui skeleton.

items.name: alert
items.description: Displays a callout for user attention. Port of shadcn/ui alert.

items.name: card
items.description: Displays a card with header, content, and footer. Port of shadcn/ui card.

items.name: input
items.description: A native form input with theme styling. Port of shadcn/ui input.

items.name: textarea
items.description: A native multi-line text input with theme styling. Port of shadcn/ui textarea.

items.name: checkbox
items.description: A native checkbox styled with pure CSS. Port of shadcn/ui checkbox.

items.name: switch
items.description: A native toggle switch styled with pure CSS. Port of shadcn/ui switch.

items.name: tabs
items.description: A set of layered sections of content, displayed one at a time. Port of shadcn/ui tabs.

items.name: accordion
items.description: A vertically stacked set of collapsible sections. Port of shadcn/ui accordion.

items.name: radio-group
items.description: A set of native radio buttons where only one can be selected. Port of shadcn/ui radio-group.

items.name: select
items.description: A native select styled like shadcn/ui's native-select, with a themeable chevron.

items.name: form-field
items.description: A label + control + description + error composition helper that wires ids and aria. Port of shadcn/ui field.

items.name: dialog
items.description: A modal dialog overlaying the page. Port of shadcn/ui dialog.

items.name: table
items.description: A responsive table built from real table elements. Port of shadcn/ui table.
